yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-supplier-scorecard
  title: Supplier Scorecard
  description: Supplier Scorecard contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_supplier_scorecard_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/supplier_scorecard
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/supplier_scorecard
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_supplier_scorecard_v1
    sourceDigest: 58b543e03bcedb2c53fa2873089ae978ab890dc71cccbd9973bac73e343fd819
spec:
  role: review
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Supplier Scorecard
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: scorecard-period
              name: scorecard_period
              label: Scorecard Period
              description: Reporting period.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: next-review-date
              name: next_review_date
              label: Next Review Date
              description: Next review date.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: commodity-category
              name: commodity_category
              label: Commodity Category
              description: Commodity, material group, or category.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: quality-ppm
              name: quality_ppm
              label: Quality Ppm
              description: Defective parts per million or quality PPM.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
            - id: nonconformance-count
              name: nonconformance_count
              label: Nonconformance Count
              description: Number of nonconformances.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
            - id: overall-score
              name: overall_score
              label: Overall Score
              description: Overall score.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
        - id: financials
          title: Financials
          description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: on-time-delivery-rate
              name: on_time_delivery_rate
              label: On Time Delivery Rate
              description: On-time delivery rate percentage.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
              required: true
            - id: cost-variance-percent
              name: cost_variance_percent
              label: Cost Variance Percent
              description: Cost variance percentage.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
        - id: line-items
          title: Line Items
          description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: corrective-actions-open
              name: corrective_actions_open
              label: Corrective Actions Open
              description: Open corrective actions.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: supplier-name
              name: supplier_name
              label: Supplier Name
              description: Supplier name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: supplier-id
              name: supplier_id
              label: Supplier Id
              description: Supplier identifier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: supplier-tier
              name: supplier_tier
              label: Supplier Tier
              description: Preferred, approved, conditional, probation, disqualified, or other tier.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: review-owner
              name: review_owner
              label: Review Owner
              description: Owner of supplier review.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: responsiveness-rating
              name: responsiveness_rating
              label: Responsiveness Rating
              description: Responsiveness rating.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: scorecard-period-present
      severity: error
      description: scorecard_period is required for Supplier Scorecard extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: scorecard_period
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: scorecard_period
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: scorecard_period IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(scorecard_period)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: supplier-name-present
      severity: error
      description: supplier_name is required for Supplier Scorecard extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: supplier_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: supplier_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(supplier_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: on-time-delivery-rate-present
      severity: error
      description: on_time_delivery_rate is required for Supplier Scorecard extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: on_time_delivery_rate
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: on_time_delivery_rate
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: on_time_delivery_rate IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(on_time_delivery_rate)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: quality-ppm-present
      severity: error
      description: quality_ppm is required for Supplier Scorecard extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: quality_ppm
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: quality_ppm
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: quality_ppm IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(quality_ppm)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: overall-score-present
      severity: error
      description: overall_score is required for Supplier Scorecard extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: overall_score
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: overall_score
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: overall_score IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(overall_score)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: on-time-delivery-rate-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: on_time_delivery_rate should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: on_time_delivery_rate
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: on_time_delivery_rate
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: on_time_delivery_rate IS NULL OR on_time_delivery_rate >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: quality-ppm-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: quality_ppm should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: quality_ppm
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: quality_ppm
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: quality_ppm IS NULL OR quality_ppm >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: nonconformance-count-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: nonconformance_count should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: nonconformance_count
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: nonconformance_count
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: nonconformance_count IS NULL OR nonconformance_count >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: cost-variance-percent-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: cost_variance_percent should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: cost_variance_percent
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: cost_variance_percent
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: cost_variance_percent IS NULL OR cost_variance_percent >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: overall-score-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: overall_score should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: overall_score
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: overall_score
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: overall_score IS NULL OR overall_score >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      supplier_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Supplier Scorecard workflow.
      on_time_delivery_rate:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Supplier Scorecard workflow.
      quality_ppm:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Supplier Scorecard workflow.
      overall_score:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Supplier Scorecard workflow.
      scorecard_period:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Supplier scorecard extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Supplier Scorecard documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and operational
      control context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      scorecard_period:
        type: string
        description: Reporting period.
      supplier_name:
        type: string
        description: Supplier name.
      supplier_id:
        type: string
        description: Supplier identifier.
      commodity_category:
        type: string
        description: Commodity, material group, or category.
      on_time_delivery_rate:
        type: number
        description: On-time delivery rate percentage.
      quality_ppm:
        type: number
        description: Defective parts per million or quality PPM.
      nonconformance_count:
        type: integer
        description: Number of nonconformances.
      cost_variance_percent:
        type: number
        description: Cost variance percentage.
      responsiveness_rating:
        type: string
        description: Responsiveness rating.
      overall_score:
        type: number
        description: Overall score.
      supplier_tier:
        type: string
        description: Preferred, approved, conditional, probation, disqualified, or other tier.
      corrective_actions_open:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Open corrective actions.
      review_owner:
        type: string
        description: Owner of supplier review.
      next_review_date:
        type: date
        description: Next review date.
        format: date
    required:
      - scorecard_period
      - supplier_name
      - on_time_delivery_rate
      - quality_ppm
      - overall_score
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - scorecard_period
            - supplier_name
            - on_time_delivery_rate
            - quality_ppm
            - overall_score
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - financials
            - line_items
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
